title: Payment Arrangements Policy — Interaction With Settlements, Hardship Holds and Account Closure
content:
Plans under Payment Arrangements are set up and ended in step with the account's settlements, hardship holds and closure.

## Clauses

**1. Settlements.** A payment plan and an accepted settlement never run on the same account. A plan is set up only when no settlement on the account has status accepted; an open settlement offer does not block a plan and stays open until it expires or is accepted.

**2. Settlement accepted over a plan.** When a settlement on an account is accepted while a plan on that account is pending authorization, active, suspended or broken, the plan is cancelled the same day with the close reason "superseded by settlement", and installments already paid stay applied to the account.

**3. Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan.** A Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan is set up only when the account's most recent hardship hold has status ended and its ended date is no more than that hold tier's post-hold hardship window, in calendar days, before the creation date, and that hold tier makes a hardship plan eligible after the hold; a consumer whose hold is still active must first have the hold ended, and a consumer whose hold ended outside the window or under a tier that does not qualify takes an ordinary plan type instead. The post-hold hardship window and the hardship-plan eligibility are figures of the hold's tier under Hardship and Protective Holds.

**4. Returned or resolved accounts.** A plan is also cancelled, with the close reason "account returned", when its account is returned to the client, and with the close reason "account resolved otherwise" when the account becomes paid in full through payments outside the plan.

## Evidence

Settlement status and hardship hold status, ended date and tier are read from Ridgeline's records for the same placed account, before the plan is set up.

| Settlement status on the account | Blocks a new plan under clause 1 |
|---|---|
| Accepted | Yes |
| Offered (open offer) | No |
| Expired | No |
| Withdrawn | No |
| Defaulted | No |

## Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan — condition table

| Most recent hardship hold ended | Ended within the tier's window before creation | Tier makes a hardship plan eligible after the hold | Hardship Reduced-Payment Plan |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | May be set up |
| No — hold still active | — | — | Not set up; the hold is ended first |
| Yes | No | any | Not set up; an ordinary plan type instead |
| Yes | any | No | Not set up; an ordinary plan type instead |

**Boundary (hypothetical dates).** For a hold tier whose window is 30 calendar days and a hold that ended on 1 March, a creation date of 31 March is 30 days after the ended date and within the window; a creation date of 1 April is 31 days after it and outside the window.
